A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ReMemR1 research. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–F are available and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original QA accuracy, ablations, training curves, computational measurements, and case studies in Section 3 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v5 retains the original QA experiments, ablations, training curves, computational measurements, and case studies.

M1.justification: The history-augmented memory state, callback retrieval procedure, multi-level rewards, and GRPO training objective remain unchanged in Section 2 and Appendix C.1.

E1.justification: Both versions train on HotpotQA and evaluate on HotpotQA and 2WikiMultiHopQA, including the same reversed-order, distant-evidence scenario in Section 3.3.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same baselines, including MemAgent, rule-based callback, Qwen2.5, Qwen2.5-1M, R1-Distill-Qwen, Qwen3, and QwenLong-L1-32B. The added references do not introduce evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The protocols remain unchanged: 200 documents per training example, 50–6400 documents at evaluation, 128 sampled examples per benchmark, and the same model, chunk, metric, and ablation settings.

E4.justification: Both retain the reward-weight sweep, RL versus no-RL ablation, callback comparison, distant-evidence test, training-dynamics analyses, and success and failure cases. The training-cost analysis is relocated rather than added.

E5.justification: Both specify subsampling seed 4 in Appendix C.3 and fixed-seed dataset generation in the reproducibility statement. Neither reports repeated-run uncertainty summaries, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Matched benchmark, ablation, efficiency, and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, 7B ReMemR1 retains 80.8% HotpotQA and 50.3% 2WikiMultiHopQA accuracy at 6400 documents. v2 Table 7 and v5 Table 2 contain identical training-cost measurements.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13, the memory-agent formulation, reward definitions, training objective, and Appendix D complexity arguments retain the same mathematical content and assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about callback-enabled reasoning, multi-level supervision, accuracy, generalization, and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: The interpretations of memory loss, callback benefits, reward balance, and computational overhead remain unchanged. Appendix B.5 retains the same recall-collapse and memory-pollution limitations; the training-overhead interpretation simply moves into the main text.

D1.justification: Code-access statements, framework descriptions, prompt templates, Table 8 hyperparameters, H800 hardware, and training-time disclosures are unchanged. Relocating the training-cost table adds no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: v5 adds citations and references for DeepResearch Bench, A-RAG, and Memocr in the introduction and related-work discussion. These modestly update coverage without substantially changing the paper's research positioning.

P1.justification: v5 shortens introductory explanations, corrects references from Figure 2 to Figure 1, adds acknowledgements, and updates the publication header. It also splits Section 3.4 into inference and training efficiency, moving the latter discussion from Appendix B.4.2.

P2.justification: The training-cost table moves from appendix Table 7 to main-text Table 2, and the reward-weight table moves to page 10. Subsequent tables are renumbered and case-study boxes reflow; the eight figures and table contents remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v5 modestly improves clarity by correcting introductory figure references and placing the existing training-cost evidence in Section 3.4.2 and Table 2, making the efficiency discussion easier to assess. The citation updates provide a limited additional benefit. The methodology, empirical evidence, and documented limitations remain unchanged.
